violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Onions sliced last weekend were not date marked.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Dried food debris/spill at bottom interior of stainless refrigerator.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. -Sanitizer greater than 100ppm Chlorine.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Prep table has debris at edges, residue at front of doors. -Debris at underside of cutting board. -Spill in bottom of stainless refrigerator.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
